spec_features.spec_quote: The subject may emit `<GIVE_UP>` in its text to end the rollout
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:35 GIVE_UP_SENTINEL = "<GIVE_UP>"; system prompt at harness.py:43-44 tells the subject it may emit the token to stop; detection at harness.py:328 `gave_up = GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in resp.assistant_text`; honored at harness.py:346-347 `if gave_up: rollout.stop_cause = "give_up"; break` which ends the rollout loop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end enforced: real instruction text delivered to subject, substring-checked each turn, and the loop is broken when present. The token is detected after the turn is recorded (the assistant's give-up turn still completes), but it does terminate the rollout.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If you conclude the task cannot be completed, you may emit the token <GIVE_UP> to stop; this is optional.
